prior_review_preservation: 02a_independent_pre_outcome_review_v1_rejection.json preserves the rejection receipt verbatim, remains authoritative for the packet it reviewed and grants no rights to this revision.

current_product_contract.decision: Five D1-D5 layers are mandatory; D3_PRODUCT_VOLUME is optional.

material_finding_remediations.why_the_prior_packet_was_below_standard: At the time of review, production registration required a separate D3_PRODUCT_VOLUME claim, while R-104 carried only the five D1-D5 layers.
material_finding_remediations.economic_impact: Copying D2 sales volume into a product-throughput claim would falsely claim observability and could misattribute volume deleveraging or fixed-cost absorption.
missing_facts: recurring exact FY2013-FY2015 whole-issuer production throughput
recurring whole-issuer sell-through or capacity utilization
prohibited_assumptions: D2 sales volume equals production throughput
FY2015 rounded production growth reconstructs an exact FY2014 amount
material_finding_remediations.executable_remediation: Apply the subsequent product decision consistently: retain the five mandatory layers, leave optional D3_PRODUCT_VOLUME UNKNOWN, do not register it and give it no vote.
material_finding_remediations.acceptance_criteria: A fresh reviewer confirms the current control plane accepts the ordered five mandatory stages, no R-104 artifact creates a product-volume claim, D2 cannot substitute and the UNKNOWN layer is non-voting.

material_finding_remediations.why_the_prior_packet_was_below_standard: The prior D3 divided a whole-issuer contribution numerator by headline beer sales volume with a different activity perimeter.
material_finding_remediations.economic_impact: Non-beer or commissioned-processing activity could cross a per-kilolitre threshold without proving network-pruning economics.
missing_facts: an audited allocation bridge from whole-issuer accounts to beer-only and commissioned-processing activity
prohibited_assumptions: legal consolidation alone aligns a whole-issuer numerator with a beer-only denominator
material_finding_remediations.executable_remediation: Remove the denominator. D3 now measures revenue less cost, taxes and surcharges, selling expense and administrative expense as a whole-issuer RMB amount for FY2013-FY2016.
material_finding_remediations.acceptance_criteria: Every D3 component uses the consolidated issuer perimeter, no activity denominator remains in the central test, and the FY2013-FY2015 amounts reproduce exactly.

material_finding_remediations.why_the_prior_packet_was_below_standard: The prior 5%, 13% and 10% boundaries were not tied to network capital at risk, overlapped the simple baseline and misstated the FY2014-FY2015 per-kilolitre change.
material_finding_remediations.economic_impact: Arbitrary or overlapping central voter ranges could create A_ONLY or B_ONLY without a material normal-profit or owner-cash consequence.
prohibited_assumptions: a round percentage is economically material
repeating the baseline demonstrates incremental cash efficiency
material_finding_remediations.executable_remediation: Use the cutoff-before RMB204,449,973.25 six-plant fixed-asset impairment as capital at risk. One annual five-year recovery step is RMB40,889,994.65; add or subtract that step from the FY2015 D3 and D4 baselines and preserve all middle observations as MIXED. D4 first removes positive working-capital release from OCF less all long-term-asset acquisition cash.
material_finding_remediations.acceptance_criteria: A fresh reviewer independently reproduces the RMB40,889,994.65 step, all D3/D4 boundaries and the RMB30,667,495.99 illustrative after-tax consequence; D4 is the scalar owner cash after removing positive working-capital release, and the H-A, baseline, H-B and MIXED regions are non-overlapping.

material_finding_remediations.why_the_prior_packet_was_below_standard: The old review began before material D3 edits were complete, so its freeze timestamp did not identify the reviewed packet.
material_finding_remediations.economic_impact: A stale receipt could authorize outcome access under a central economic rule that had not actually been frozen.
missing_facts: a separate independent review recorded after that timestamp
prohibited_assumptions: the old rejection receipt accepts this revision
material_finding_remediations.executable_remediation: After the last material packet edit, record a timezone-aware freeze timestamp in 01_case_freeze.json, run targeted validation, then have the fresh independent reviewer write the current v2 receipt in 02_independent_pre_outcome_review.json while leaving 02a_independent_pre_outcome_review_v1_rejection.json unchanged.
material_finding_remediations.acceptance_criteria: The final freeze timestamp is valid and earlier than the fresh reviewed_at; no material packet edit occurs between them; the new receipt reviews all current packet files and separately attests zero post-cutoff metadata/body access.

fresh_review_requirement.required_new_artifact: 02_independent_pre_outcome_review.json as the current v2 independent receipt; the selector must not write it and 02a_independent_pre_outcome_review_v1_rejection.json must remain unchanged
does_not_grant: post-cutoff title, filename, snippet, body, value, result or metadata access
outcome settlement, diagnosis or learning transfer
method win, accuracy or probability claims
security-price, valuation, return or portfolio conclusions

outcome_access_attestation.attestation: This remediation used only the already selected cutoff-before packet, the preserved rejection and the current local product contract. No post-cutoff title, filename, snippet, body, report existence, value, security price, valuation or result was queried or read.
